## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Works on macOS, Linux and Windows (or the PR says which OS it targets and why)
- [ ] User files are only changed between our markers; edited files are backed up
- [ ] Running the command twice gives the same result
- [ ] Docs updated (EN; PT optional)
- [ ] Line added under `Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No secrets or personal data
